purpose: Labelled corpus for a manual aif-adr-check-consistency run. Not read by npm test: the skill is judged by a person against these labels. buildDecisions must report zero issues here.

contradiction.why: one assigns the order id in application code as a 128-bit UUIDv7, the other assigns it in the database as a 64-bit sequence value; both claim the same scope
contradiction.expected_follow_up: aif-adr-refine on adr-order-ids-sequence, the accepted one
contradiction.lexical: shared vocabulary — order id, database, region

contradiction.why: one requires a migration file to carry no down step, the other requires a down step and has the deploy tool refuse migrations without one
contradiction.expected_follow_up: name the conflict and stop; which one yields is the operator's call

contradiction.why: one rules that a process holds no caller data between 2 requests, the other rules that the checkout module keeps every basket in process memory keyed by visitor; the second is caller data held between requests
contradiction.expected_follow_up: name the conflict and stop; both are active and protected, so the direction of replacement is the operator's call
contradiction.lexical: no shared vocabulary — session/token/caller against basket/shopper/visitor. This is the pair a lexical prefilter would miss, and the reason the skill reads the whole digest instead.

redundant.why: adr-structured-logging obliges nothing that adr-logs-json does not already oblige: same scope, same excludes, one JSON object per line, fixed key names
redundant.expected_follow_up: name the overlap and stop; the pairing for supersede is the operator's call

shared_area.why: both rule the shared HTTP client and both state numeric limits, but a deadline and a retry budget are satisfiable together
shared_area.trap: a verdict of contradiction here is a false positive

shared_area.why: both rule order events and share affects: [orders, events]; one governs the transport and topic, the other the payload, and each excludes the other's subject
shared_area.trap: a verdict of contradiction here is a false positive
